name: Lisse
title: Sentinel of the Evenway
examine: Old blood, whole. She counts what moves in the wood without appearing to count anything, and the count is never wrong.
lines: Four wolves crossed at dusk. Three crossed back. The wood settles its own arithmetic.
You may share the fire. The fire is older than the courtesy, and the courtesy is old.
The Company sent another crew for the silverbark. We sent their palisade back in bundles. Everyone is being very polite.
